about: A targeted regression for the turn-move owner under "deep" with the their-words fix (docs/TURN_MOVE_AB.md). Each case is a short scripted conversation: the person's messages, sent in order to the real backend. 'named' marks the turns the user asked to see again (the failures of A/B 2). The first five cases are the person's own messages from the A/B 2 conversations; the rest are new.
